raw_Final.answer: The net change in the balance of unrecognized tax benefits from the end of fiscal year 2007 to the end of fiscal year 2008 was an increase of $87.8 million.
raw_Final.message: End of fiscal 2008 balance = $214.4 million (table row 'balance at december 27 2008', source:t8c1n0). End of fiscal 2007 balance = $126.6 million (the beginning-of-year 2008 balance equals the end-of-2007 balance, source:t1c1n0; also the 2007 column's ending balance, source:t8c2n0). Net change = 214.4 - 126.6 = 87.8 USD million.
